Frequently Asked Questions (Reasoning LLM Cost Calculator)

How do reasoning/thinking tokens impact API costs?

Reasoning models (like DeepSeek R1, OpenAI o1, and Claude 3.7 Sonnet in thinking mode) generate intermediate chain-of-thought tokens before producing the final user response. Because these tokens are billed at the completion/output rate (which is typically 3× to 4× higher than input rates), reasoning can account for 60% to 85% of total API charges if unmonitored.

How does DeepSeek R1 pricing compare to OpenAI o1 and o3-mini?

DeepSeek R1 provides aggressive pricing at $0.55 per 1M input tokens ($0.14 cached) and $2.19 per 1M output/reasoning tokens. In comparison, OpenAI o3-mini is $1.10/$4.40 per 1M, Claude 3.7 Sonnet is $3.00/$15.00 per 1M, and OpenAI o1 is $15.00/$60.00 per 1M. DeepSeek R1 yields up to 92% cost savings on intensive reasoning workloads.

Can prompt caching reduce reasoning model costs?

Yes. OpenAI, Anthropic, and DeepSeek support prompt prefix caching. Repeated system instructions, agent definitions, and document contexts receive a 50% to 80% discount on input tokens, significantly mitigating the cost of long multi-turn agent loops.
